title: Prevent mobile sticky header clipping and fixed CTA overlap at 390x844
context_summary: Customers manage agents across phones (390px), tablets (768px), and laptops (1440px).
observation: Multi-line sticky headers clipped #trial-workspace anchor jumps and the floating mobile CTA covered Step 2 controls.
verified_action: Compact mobile sticky nav, set scroll-margin-top:148px, hide .mcta when #trial-workspace is in view, and enforce 18x18 inline checkboxes.
